title: People Operations & HR Generalist
description: Drive employee lifecycle management, onboarding, HR policy compliance, and performance management across distributed African teams. Experience with HRIS (BambooHR/Workday), employee relations, and Nigerian labor laws.

title: Learning & Development Specialist (L&D)

title: HR Business Partner (HRBP)
description: Strategic people partner collaborating with department heads on talent planning, employee engagement, compensation reviews, and organizational design. SHRM or CIPM certification preferred.

title: Recruitment & Onboarding Coordinator
description: Coordinate candidate interview scheduling, ATS pipeline tracking, offer letters, background checks, and remote new hire onboarding. Excellent communication and organization skills.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner
description: Global remote hiring partner scaling Go-To-Market and corporate teams. Deep experience in international talent sourcing, ATS management (Lever/Greenhouse), and high-volume recruiting.
